## Blood Donation 🩸 Camp on 10/01/2023

News Date : 10 Jan 2023News ReportBe the reason for someone’s existence…While truly believing in this, NSS-MGIT in association with Aaradhya Blood Bank & Lions Club, Jubilee hills, organized a Blood Donation 🩸 Camp on 10/01/2023 to encourage young Students, NSS volunteers, Faculty & Staff members to donate blood and help save lives.On this occasion Principal, MGIT,Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy said, there is no greater act of service to mankind than to donate blood and encouraged the students to take part in this drive.NSS Unit program officer, Dr. G. Bal Reddy said 93 units of blood were donated under the supervision of medical practitioners and paramedics.Principal, Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy,Vice Principal, Prof. K. Sudhakar Reddy, Dr. S. Raji Reddy, Dr. M. Ravi Chandar & Lions Club Members also were present and praised all donors and NSS volunteers who made the camp a success by selfless act of blood donation, promotion, and motivation.
